reason: After reviewing the Cboe Global Markets 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The filing contains detailed segment revenue breakdowns (Options, North American Equities, Europe and Asia Pacific, Futures, Global FX, and Digital segments), transaction volumes, market share data, and financial metrics, but does not include any company-stated TAM estimates or market size figures. The document focuses on operational performance, competitive positioning, and regulatory matters rather than quantifying addressable market opportunities.
